In the past, I felt burdened and annoyed by the thought of washing dishes every time I cooked, but now that stress has almost completely disappeared. Thanks to this, I can cook with a much lighter heart. I definitely feel like my quality of life has improved, so if you are considering it, I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): Design and Installation.
Comments (English): [ Finally escaped the dishwashing hell. ] || ---------------- || Design and Installation. First off, the clean white color is beautiful. Also, since it is a countertop model, it can be placed directly on the sink, making installation easy. As a tenant, the biggest advantage was that no base cabinet renovations were required. (However, drilling is necessary, but we didn't drill and instead purchased a separate part to connect it to the kitchen faucet.) Although it is a 6-person capacity model, the interior space is efficiently designed, so pots and pans fit comfortably inside. Washing Power. Even burnt-on rice and greasy dishes are cleaned perfectly, leaving them squeaky clean. Perhaps due to the high-temperature direct water spray, the dishes are cleaned to a very clear finish with no water stains remaining. Drying and Convenience. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens to release internal moisture. Without this feature, I would have been worried about internal odors or a musty smell. Since it air-dries, it is really convenient to be able to run it after work and take out fluffy dishes the next morning. (I previously used a countertop model from another company that lacked an automatic door opening function, so I always had the hassle of manually opening it at the scheduled time.) Noise Level. It is quiet enough that it is not a major concern when watching TV in the living room. I am satisfied because even running it late at night does not disturb neighbors or sleep. My personal usage tips: - Tetris Know-how: At first, I was worried about how to stack the dishes because they didn't fit in as easily as I expected. However, the instruction manual (downloadable as PDF) includes a diagram for stacking dishes, so I followed it exactly and was able to fit many. - Recommendation for dedicated detergent and rinse: I use the tablet-type detergent in its entirety. (It is a hassle to cut it.) You also need to use rinse aid to ensure the dishes are squeaky clean and free of water stains. Honest Overall Review: Pros: Quality of life has skyrocketed. I can play with my child or relax during the time I would otherwise spend washing dishes. Sentence (English): This is a nicely designed dishwasher with lots of features.
Comments (English): [ Nice but not very quiet ] || ---------------- || This is a nicely designed dishwasher with lots of features. It has a third rack which can be used for silverware and utensils which could eliminate the need for the included silverware basket. I've owned a few dishwashers with a third rack but this is the first that has a height adjustment(left half only) to accommodate larger items. The middle rack also has height adjustments, rows of tines that can be flipped down, and stemware holders for wine glasses, etc. It also connects via Wi-Fi to the LG ThinQ app which allows you to change settings or end of cycle tunes, download additional cycles that aren't available directly on the control panel, and will alert you when the cycle is finished. It has a feature which pops the door open towards the end of the cycle to allow the steam to escape so your dishes will dry quicker. This is the second dishwasher I've owned with this feature and unfortunately it doesn't work as well on the LG as it did on my previous brand. The dishes remain quite a bit wet. My biggest caveat- and this is why I didn't give it 5 stars- is that's it's one of the least quiet dishwashers I've ever owned. I hear everything loud and clear, from it filling with water to the swishing of the spray arms. I know it has nothing to do with my installation or kitchen setup because my last dishwasher was very quiet. It has a light that projects on the floor to let you know that it's running but I definitely know it's running without the light. I even added extra insulation at the bottom behind my cabinet toe kick because there was extra space there, but that didn't help.

Sentence (English): It was time to replace our existing 22-year-old KitchenAid dishwasher and after researching dishwashers I narrowed my choices to the Bosch 800 and the KitchenAid KDTS624SPS.
Comments (English): [ Replaced 22-year-old KitchenAid dishwasher ] || ---------------- || It was time to replace our existing 22-year-old KitchenAid dishwasher and after researching dishwashers I narrowed my choices to the Bosch 800 and the KitchenAid KDTS624SPS. I decided to purchase the KitchenAid dishwasher because 1) the top rack holds small dishes and glasses in addition to utensils and kitchen tools, 2) the door pops open at the end of the cycle to completely dry the dishes and 3) all my appliances are KitchenAid. I purchased the KitchenAid dishwasher from Costco.com while it was on sale. The Costco installation was very efficient, and the dishwasher fits perfectly in the spot where the old dishwasher was previously. Due to updated California building codes, the installers replaced my existing electrical outlet with a GFCI outlet under the kitchen sink before installing the new dishwasher. I usually only turn on the dishwasher once a week and I'm still trying different ways to position the various sizes of Fiestaware dishes in the 3 racks. I like the Advanced ProDry where the door pops open at the end of the cycle to completely dry the dishes. There is a small light on the top right corner of the door that has 3 different colors to indicate the various cycles: blue for washing, red for drying, and white for finishing. The controls on top of the door are very sensitive and turn on quickly, so I've learned to tap the cancel button quickly. Overall, I'm pleased with my new and quiet KitchenAid dishwasher.

Sentence (English): It has been about a month since I started using the dishwasher, and to start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner.
Comments (English): It has been about a month since I started using the dishwasher, and to start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. Washing dishes used to be the most tedious and repetitive chore of the day, but my quality of life has definitely improved since getting the dishwasher. The biggest advantage is, of course, saving time. It used to take 20 to 30 minutes to wash and rinse the dishes piled up after a meal, but now I simply shake off the food residue and put them in the dishwasher, and that's it. Since it automatically handles washing, rinsing, and drying with just the press of a single button, I can use that time to rest or do other things. The difference is significant, especially after dinner, as I can really feel the extra time I have. The cleaning performance is also better than expected. At first, I was skeptical about whether grease or stubborn food residue would be properly removed, but in actual use, I found that dishes were often cleaned more thoroughly than hand washing. Since it washes with high-temperature water, I feel reassured about hygiene, and glass cups and cutlery are finished cleanly without any water stains. However, if rice grains or dry food residue have stuck for a long time, it is best to soak them in water beforehand or pre-wash them. Water usage and electricity costs were not as burdensome as I expected. I actually felt that I used less water in some cases than when washing dishes by hand, and there was no significant change in electricity bills. In fact, considering the time and labor it saves, I believe it is a worthwhile purchase. Of course, there are downsides. First, the initial purchase cost is not insignificant, and installation space is required. You need to carefully consider the placement, especially if your kitchen is small. Also, it takes some time to get used to the way dishes are loaded, as cleaning performance can decrease if they are not arranged efficiently. Overall, a dishwasher is more than just a simple appliance; it is an item that changes your lifestyle patterns. It is definitely worth considering for anyone who wants to escape the stress of dishwashing or use their time efficiently. Personally, I plan to continue using it and would highly recommend it to those around me.

Comments (English): It has been about a month since I started using the dishwasher, and to start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. Washing dishes used to be the most tedious and repetitive chore of the day, but my quality of life has definitely improved since getting the dishwasher. The biggest advantage is, of course, saving time. It used to take 20 to 30 minutes to wash and rinse the dishes piled up after a meal, but now I simply shake off the food residue and put them in the dishwasher, and that's it. Since it automatically handles washing, rinsing, and drying with just the press of a single button, I can use that time to rest or do other things. The difference is significant, especially after dinner, as I can really feel the extra time I have. The cleaning performance is also better than expected. At first, I was skeptical about whether grease or stubborn food residue would be properly removed, but in actual use, I found that dishes were often cleaned more thoroughly than hand washing. Since it washes with high-temperature water, I feel reassured about hygiene, and glass cups and cutlery are finished cleanly without any water stains. However, if rice grains or dry food residue have stuck for a long time, it is best to soak them in water beforehand or pre-wash them. Water usage and electricity costs were not as burdensome as I expected. I actually felt that I used less water in some cases than when washing dishes by hand, and there was no significant change in electricity bills. In fact, considering the time and labor it saves, I believe it is a worthwhile purchase. Of course, there are downsides. First, the initial purchase cost is not insignificant, and installation space is required. You need to carefully consider the placement, especially if your kitchen is small. Also, it takes some time to get used to the way dishes are loaded, as cleaning performance can decrease if they are not arranged efficiently. Overall, a dishwasher is more than just a simple appliance; it is an item that changes your lifestyle patterns. It is definitely worth considering for anyone who wants to escape the stress of dishwashing or use their time efficiently. Personally, I plan to continue using it and would highly recommend it to those around me.

Sentence (English): It is definitely worth considering for anyone who wants to escape the stress of dishwashing or use their time efficiently.
Comments (English): It has been about a month since I started using the dishwasher, and to start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. Washing dishes used to be the most tedious and repetitive chore of the day, but since getting the dishwasher, my quality of life has definitely improved. The biggest advantage is, of course, saving time. It used to take 20 to 30 minutes to wash and rinse the dishes piled up after a meal, but now I simply shake off the food residue and put them in the dishwasher, and that's it. Since it automatically handles washing, rinsing, and drying with just the press of a single button, I can use that time to rest or do other things. The difference is significant, especially after dinner, as I can really feel the extra time I have. The cleaning performance is also better than expected. At first, I was skeptical about whether grease or stubborn food residue would be properly removed, but in actual use, I found that they were often cleaned more thoroughly than hand washing. Since it washes with high-temperature water, I feel reassured about hygiene, and glass cups and cutlery are finished cleanly without any water stains. However, if rice grains or dry food residue have stuck for a long time, it is advisable to soak the dishes in water or pre-wash them beforehand. Water usage and electricity costs were not as burdensome as I expected. I felt that I actually used less water than when washing dishes by hand, and there was no significant change in electricity bills. In fact, considering the time and labor savings it saves, I believe it is a worthwhile purchase. Of course, there are downsides. First, the initial purchase cost is not insignificant, and installation space is required. You need to carefully consider the placement, especially if your kitchen is small. Also, it takes some time to get used to the way dishes are loaded. This is because cleaning performance can decrease if they are not arranged efficiently. Overall, a dishwasher is more than just a simple appliance; it is an item that changes your lifestyle patterns. It is definitely worth considering for anyone who wants to escape the stress of dishwashing or use their time efficiently. Personally, I plan to continue using it and would highly recommend it to those around me.

Comments (English): [ Quirky features, quality change ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher to replace a prior KitchenAid. Even though my former dishwasher broke after 6 years, I did like the dishwasher very much so I opted to replace it with another KitchenAid. I'm actually not a fan of the third rack and all of them have it now. I've had the dishwasher for a week and wish I had looked a bit more into other options. I find the machine to be quirky and the quality is not the same as my prior machine. The racks do not roll smoothly and feel cheap in comparison. The door is light and stiff and feels rather cheap. I didn't notice in the store that the bottom rack has an empty space. I suppose it would be for pots, but I hand wash mine so that open space actually makes it a bit more challenging to load. I live alone so it's going to be fine for my needs however I don't think it would be a useful dishwasher for a family due to how the racks are laid out. It seems that I can't load as much as I could with my last unit due to the odd configuration of the racks. As I suspected the third rack is basically useless. My prior unit did not provide a countdown so I was quite shocked at the runtime for the cycles. Normal wash is a little over three hours. It seems the recommendation is to use the pro wash feature and that is a little less than three hours.Even though this dishwasher has a higher decimal rating than my previous unit, this dishwasher is louder. I think it's because the door is made differently and more cheaply. It's still a quiet dishwasher, but not as quiet as it claims to be. I can definitely hear it running from the living room where my past dishwasher, I would only hear it during certain parts of the cycle. The controls on the top are very sensitive and just opening and closing the door. It's easy to touch them. I definitely miss the controls on the front of the door. As far as performance goes, it does clean the dishes well however, the door popping open at the end of the cycle doesn't really make sense to me. I quickly learned that when it does pop open, it completely freaks out my dog so that's fun. The little arm makes noise as it pushes open the door and seems like a feature that would be easy to go bad. It did not come with a manual so I had to Google some of the features and it does appear that you can turn off the door opening at the end of the cycle, but you have to set each time. I do not see an advantage to this feature as some dishes, especially plastic will still be wet.I have granite counters, but I would imagine if you have laminate or wood the door popping open and releasing steam to the underside of the countertop would not be a good thing over a period of time. The installation team were wonderful and did a great job installing it. They actually got a better fit with the new unit than my prior dishwasher that was installed from someone else. The basket comes with a slotted cover for silverware, which I removed. This is never worked well with the silverware that I have, the handles are too thick to fit through the slots. Another wasted feature on me. Overall it's just okay. It would be a better unit if they ditched the useless third rack and spent the time and resources on better quality racks and door.

I find the machine to be quirky and the quality is not the same as my prior machine. The racks do not roll smoothly and feel cheap in comparison. The door is light and stiff and feels rather cheap. I didn’t  notice in the store that the bottom rack has an empty space. I suppose it would be for pots, but I hand wash mine so that open space actually makes it a bit more challenging to load. I live alone so it’s going to be fine for my needs however I don’t think it would be a useful dishwasher for a family due to how the racks are laid out. It seems that I can’t load as much as I could with my last unit due to the odd configuration of the racks. As I suspected the third rack is basically useless. My prior unit did not provide a countdown so I was quite shocked at the runtime for the cycles. Normal wash is a little over three hours. It seems the recommendation is to use the pro wash feature and that is a little less than three hours.Even though this dishwasher has a higher decimal rating than my previous unit, this dishwasher is louder. I think it’s because the door is made differently and more cheaply. It’s still a quiet dishwasher, but not as quiet as it claims to be. I can definitely hear it running from the living room where my past dishwasher, I would only hear it during certain parts of the cycle. The controls on the top are very sensitive and just opening and closing the door. It’s easy to touch them. I definitely miss the controls on the front of the door. As far as performance goes, it does clean the dishes well however, the door popping open at the end of the cycle doesn’t really make sense to me. I quickly learned that when it does pop open, it completely freaks out my dog so that’s fun. The little arm makes noise as it pushes open the door and seems like a feature that would be easy to go bad. It did not come with a manual so I had to Google some of the features and it does appear that you can turn off the door opening at the end of the cycle, but you have to set each time. I do not see an advantage to this feature as some dishes, especially plastic will still be wet.I have granite counters, but I would imagine if you have laminate or wood the door popping open and releasing steam to the underside of the countertop would not be a good thing over a period of time. The installation team were wonderful and did a great job installing it. They actually got a better fit with the new unit than my prior dishwasher that was installed from someone else. The basket comes with a slotted cover for silverware, which I removed. This is never worked well with the silverware that I have, the handles are too thick to fit through the slots. Another wasted feature on me. Overall it’s just okay. It would be a better unit if they ditched the useless third rack and spent the time and resources on better quality racks and door.

Sentence (English): Whoever designed the interior of the Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher clearly has never loaded an actual dish in their life.
Comments (English): [ Madness Reigns ] || ---------------- || Whoever designed the interior of the Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher clearly has never loaded an actual dish in their life. The shelves aren't “flexible,” they're bewildering. Every tine, fold, and adjustable segment feels like it exists for a very specific, theoretical object that no normal household owns.Loading this thing isn't a routine, it's a Tetris match played under duress. You stand there, holding a bowl, rotating it like it's a puzzle piece, trying to figure out which bizarre angle the machine will accept without punishing you later with half-clean results.The spacing is just… off. Plates lean awkwardly, cups never quite sit right, and anything slightly oversized turns the entire rack into a cascading failure. You don't load dishes, you negotiate with geometry.And the back section? Absolute chaos. It's like someone reversed the logic halfway through the design process. You end up reaching into this cramped, backward zone, trying to wedge items into positions that feel fundamentally incorrect, all while hoping—hoping—that water will somehow reach them.It honestly feels Kafkaesque. There's no intuitive flow, no “of course that goes there” moment. Just a quiet, creeping realization that you're adapting yourself to the machine, not the other way around. You start questioning your own judgment. Am I loading this wrong? Is this how it's supposed to be? At some point you have to wonder: did a patent prevent them from using basic, human logic? Because this layout feels less like thoughtful design and more like a constraint puzzle someone forgot to solve.End result: dishes crammed in at unnatural angles, inconsistent cleaning, and a user experience that makes you feel like you failed an exam you didn't know you were taking.

I watched them as the did it, and install seemed easy. I didn't know how I would like the controls on the top of the door rather than the front, but I must say that I like the top controls. There is, of course, a lower rack that has plenty of places for plates and some of the plate racks can be flattened to allow for big pots. There is also a big silverware container that holds a lot of silverware. The second rack is adjustable to help you fit taller cups and items. It is simple to adjust. Just use the push buttons on each side of the rack and it lowers or raises. The third rack is quite shallow but it is perfect for knives, spatulas, and cup lids. This is my favorite feature of the dishwasher.It washes well and gets the dishes squeaky clean. You have a spot for rinseaid which helps with drying, but the way this washer dries without rinseaid, there is minimal moisture when the wash gets done. The reason for this is that the door pops slightly open when the cycle and drying is complete. I love this LG Dishwasher. I highly recommend.

There is also an auto setting that senses how soiled your dishes are and washes accordingly. LG has an app that you can connect your dishwasher through wifi and get more settings. I also like that there is a countdown timer on top to let you know how long you have left in the wash cycle. As for the interior of this washer, I love the amenities that it provides. There is, of course, a lower rack that has plenty of places for plates and some of the plate racks can be flattened to allow for big pots. There is also a big silverware container that holds a lot of silverware. The second rack is adjustable to help you fit taller cups and items. It is simple to adjust. Just use the push buttons on each side of the rack and it lowers or raises. The third rack is quite shallow but it is perfect for knives, spatulas, and cup lids. This is my favorite feature of the dishwasher.It washes well and gets the dishes squeaky clean. You have a spot for rinseaid which helps with drying, but the way this washer dries without rinseaid, there is minimal moisture when the wash gets done. Comments (English): [ The dishwasher is really convenient and I love it! ] || ---------------- || If you were to ask me if I could go back to before I bought this dishwasher, I would say I wouldn't—that is how satisfied I am. Sentence (English): While choosing home appliances for our new home, I started looking into the most popular dishwashers.
Comments (English): While choosing home appliances for our new home, I started looking into the most popular dishwashers. Among them, the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher looked so beautiful with its signature matte colors and minimalist design that it fit perfectly in my kitchen. After actually using it, I was highly satisfied because of its diverse functions. First, the cleaning power was excellent, as it cleanly removed grease and stubborn stains using high-temperature steam. Second, since it uses hot air drying rather than natural drying, it was convenient to be able to store dishes immediately with almost no water remaining. Third, I found it very convenient that it automatically adjusts the cleaning intensity by detecting the level of dirt on the dishes. And the noise, which was my biggest concern! I liked that the operating noise is low, so I could use it without worry even at night. Finally, the most satisfying aspect was its storage capacity. Kitchen tools like large pots and pans fit comfortably inside, and since the height is adjustable, I felt it was incredibly versatile. It is a product that satisfies me in every way, from design to performance!

Sentence (English): Pros: At first, I wondered if I really needed a dishwasher, but now I can't go back to the days without one.
Comments (English): Pros: At first, I wondered if I really needed a dishwasher, but now I can't go back to the days without one. Since it's the LG Dios Objet Collection, the design is incredibly clean and luxurious, instantly livening up the kitchen atmosphere. I'm also satisfied that, being a built-in unit, it blends in naturally without standing out. With a 12-place setting capacity, the ample space allows me to load dishes, pots, and pans all at once, drastically reducing my dishwashing stress. I'm always surprised by how cleanly even greasy dishes come out, even without pre-washing. The noise is quieter than expected, so it doesn't bother me much even when running it at night, and the drying is so thorough that almost no water remains. Since dishwashing time has been reduced, my evenings feel much more relaxed. Cons: When using it for the first time, the proper way to arrange the dishes can be a bit confusing; you'll go through a few trial-and-error attempts wondering, "Is this right?" Also, since it's a built-in unit, checking the space before installation is essential, and scheduling the installation can be a bit of a hassle. The price isn't exactly cheap either, so you'll likely think it over at least once before purchasing. Overall Review. To summarize, it is a life-changing appliance that reduces dishwashing stress. It is so convenient that once you use it, it is hard to go back to washing dishes by hand, and the beautiful design further enhances my satisfaction. Although it is on the price, I feel like it elevates my quality of life, so I have no regrets. I highly recommend it, especially for families or newlyweds.

Sentence (English): I am satisfied with the cleaning performance itself, as any dishwasher works well, but the standard wash time is 3 hours and 50 minutes (230 minutes).
Comments (English): [ I'm satisfied with the product itself. ] || ---------------- || I am satisfied with the cleaning performance itself, as any dishwasher works well, but the standard wash time is 3 hours and 50 minutes (230 minutes). At first, I thought I had misread it. It is absurd that the standard wash takes 3 hours and 50 minutes—a difference of 2 hours and 13 minutes—when even the powerful wash takes only 1 hour and 37 minutes. I have used various dishwashers from LG, Chinese brands, and Samsung, but this is the first model that takes nearly 4 hours on the standard setting. I remember an 8-place setting Samsung dishwasher released three years ago taking about 1 hour and 30 minutes, so I am curious why the initial value is so long. Regarding rinse aid usage, older models allowed adjustment directly from the rinse dispenser, but recent models require adjustment after connecting via SmartThings. While this might be convenient for users familiar with IoT, it could be a drawback for the elderly. It is disappointing that Samsung lacks a water softening system using ion exchange to prevent water stains, which are common in dishwashers. I hope this feature will be added in the future.
Comments (Original): [ 제품 자체는 만족스럽네유 ] || ---------------- || 세척 자체는 어느 식기 세척기나 잘 되기 때문에 만족스럽습니다만, 표준 세척 시간이 3시간 50분(230분)입니다 ㄷㄷ. 처음에 제가 잘못 본 줄 알았습니다. 강력 세척도 1시간 37분인데 표준이 3시간 50분으로 2시간 13분이나 더 걸리는 점이 황당하네요. 엘지, 중국산, 삼성 식세기 여러개를 다 써봤지만 표준에서 4시간 가까운 시간이 소모되는 건 이 모델이 처음입니다. 3년 전에 나온 8인용 삼성 식세기가 1시간 30분 정도 소모됐던거로 기억하는데 어떤 이유로 이렇게 초기값이 긴지가 궁금하네요.린스 사용량 조절의 경우 구형 모델들은 린스통에서 조절할 수 있었지만 최근 제품들은 스마트싱스 연동 후 조절해야 합니다. iot에 익숙한 사용자는 편리하겠지만 고령층에겐 단점으로 작용할 수 있겠네요.엘지는 식기세척기에서 흔히 발생하는 물얼룩 방지를 위해 이온 교환을 이용한 연수장치가 있는데 삼성엔 그러한 기능이 없다는 점이 아쉽습니다. 추후 동일한 기능이 추가됐으면 하는 바람입니다

Once you get in it, it's OK but it's the entire process that I absolutely HATE! I don't like using that word lightly and I'm not. If I could throw this dishwasher out the window and get another one I would however I've been in my home about 30 days now and it's beyond my time to return it. I know, you're going to say I should've returned it earlier or spoken up earlier. Due to medical issues with family members, I was not able to do this hospital stays seem to be a little bit more important than returning a dishwasher. I still hate it and I'm not happy! Make it easy to use!

Sentence (English): This machine is impressive.
Comments (English): [ Wow! Super Quiet and Plates Squeaky Clean ] || ---------------- || This machine is impressive. It is the first appliance I have used where using the AUTOMATIC (instsead of choosing HEAVY or NORMAL) selection actually works well. Items come out extremely clean. And wow, how quiet! Here are some points which address some of the negative reviews: 1. Instead of an indicator light, there is a count down timer that projects on the floor. When finished, the timer disappears. 2. When finished, water drops can still be found on the inside walls of the machine because of the drying technology used. Instead of bringing in outside air it uses temperature to draw the moisture from the hot dishes to the cool walls. This is much mitigated by using the CRYSTAL DRY option, which adds some time to the cycle. 3. Without the app, there are plenty of cycles available, and I do not miss not using the app. For the extra POWER CONTROL for the bottom rack, I can choose extra power for the FRONT or REAR of the rack, which is just fine for me. I think the app can reduce the power area to quadrants, or perhaps even all of the rack, but I don't find I need the app at all. Great product, Bosch!

Sentence (English): #CareService #ApplianceSubscription.
Comments (English): #CareService #ApplianceSubscription. I purchased the dishwasher because I heard it was a must-have for newlyweds. I felt that for appliances like a dishwasher, it's better to manage them with a care service rather than just cleaning other things, so I subscribed and am using the care service as well! I also appreciated that if consumables weren't due for replacement yet compared to the last visit, they didn't replace them immediately but provided spares to keep. The service took about 20 minutes. I was very satisfied because there was no odor after the care and it felt much cleaner. I took several photos for your reference. I think I would recommend the subscription that includes the care service to those who find cleaning themselves a hassle or those who care about hygiene.

Sentence (English): I really loved using my previous SK dishwasher.
Comments (English): I really loved using my previous SK dishwasher. However, after six years, it suddenly started breaking down here and there. I was looking for a new one while moving, but since I was so satisfied with my old one, products from other companies didn't really catch my eye. It was the same even when I went to the store. Above all, since I use woks and pots so frequently and cook greasy food often, washing dishes by hand was simply unbearable for me. Then I heard that a 14-place setting model had been released, so I ordered it right away. I was skeptical right up until the day of installation, but the more I use it, the more I love it! The color is pretty, but I also like everything about it, such as the automatic opening, sterilization, hot air, and the fact that it operates on a Grade 1 energy setting. The app integration is also great, so if I follow the guide for maintenance, I think I'll be able to use it for a long time.^^

Sentence (English): I bought this because I wanted to reduce the time spent washing dishes since I have children.
Comments (English): I bought this because I wanted to reduce the time spent washing dishes since I have children. I debated a lot about whether to buy a 12-place or 14-place model or a countertop one, but I ended up buying the countertop one. However, since it takes up a lot of space, the kitchen does look a bit cramped. I tend to use a lot of space when cooking, so that is. Still, I like it because it saves time on washing dishes and does a much better job than I do. I am still using my old 2-tier dish drying rack, so the space might look even smaller, but I am satisfied with the dishwasher overall.

Comments (English): [ So quiet and powerful. ] || ---------------- || I've been using the Bosch SHX9PCM5N for a few months now, and honestly, it's one of those purchases I wish I had made sooner. The first thing I noticed was how unbelievably quiet it is—I actually had to check that it was running the first time I turned it on. But beyond that, the cleaning performance is just outstanding. I've put in everything from baked-on casserole dishes to greasy pans, and they come out spotless every time without me needing to pre-rinse. What really makes a difference day-to-day is how thoughtfully it's designed. The racks are super flexible, and I love the third rack for utensils—it frees up so much space below. I can fit way more in a single load than I expected, which has cut down how often I run it. And the drying is seriously impressive, especially for plastics, which used to come out damp in my old dishwasher. With this one, everything is dry and ready to put away right away. Overall, it just feels like a high-end, well-built appliance that makes life easier. The controls are simple, the app connectivity is actually useful, and it runs efficiently without me thinking about it. It's one of those appliances that quietly does its job so well that you forget about it—but in the best way. If you're on the fence, I'd absolutely recommend it—it's been worth every penny for me.

Sentence (English): Using a dishwasher and an induction cooktop together definitely made a difference in the convenience of my kitchen life.
Comments (English): Using a dishwasher and an induction cooktop together definitely made a difference in the convenience of my kitchen life. Both were such satisfying appliances that once you get used to them, it would be a shame to go back to not having them. The dishwasher was incredibly convenient as it significantly reduced the burden of washing dishes after meals. Being able to put in dishes, cutlery, and cups all at once saved time and effort, and I was satisfied with how effectively it removed water stains and grease. It was particularly useful on busy days or after guests had visited. I also liked that it felt more hygienic than washing by hand. The induction cooktop made kitchen maintenance much easier because cooking speeds were fast and the surface remained clean. It felt like the heat transfer was faster than a gas stove, and cleaning was much simpler since I only had to wipe the surface after use. I was also satisfied that the kitchen looked more sophisticated and organized overall. Using both products together made the entire process from cooking to cleaning much more efficient. I could cook quickly and cleanly with the induction cooktop when preparing food, and finish up with the dishwasher after meals, which significantly reduced the burden of housework. While the price might seem a bit steep at first, I believe it is a fully satisfying choice once you actually use it, as the time savings and convenience are significant. It is a combination I would recommend to those looking to replace their kitchen appliances all at once or those considering appliances for a new home.

While the price might seem a bit steep at first, I believe it is a fully satisfying choice once you actually use it, as the time savings and convenience are significant. Sentence (English): This is our second Bosch 800 series dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Cleans Great! ] || ---------------- || This is our second Bosch 800 series dishwasher. This one replaced a unit that we bought in 2013. This new dishwasher is a champ at cleaning the dishes and is extremely quiet. I love the adjustability of the top rack. The Crystal Dry function is remarkably better than standard drying of plastic items. Some changes were made between 2013 and 2026 and I don't love them all. The stainless finish on the handle and the front are quite resistant to fingerprints. I don't love that the door is more tightly sprung to close on its own. The light for "clean" on my panel does not light up after the cycle has been run. I do run the dishwasher at night and it may be that this feature times out by the time I open the dishwasher in the morning. The silverware rack is much smaller. Thankfully, our retailer gave us an additional basket to offset that issue. I miss the plastic handle on the lower rack. The wire pull feels cheap. I've looked for a part to purchase and haven't been successful. The middle rack is used for glasses and bowls at our house. The tines on the right side of the rack used to have the option of laying flat. Now they are fixed and don't allow our bowls to seat well. The middle and upper racks glide less smoothly than our previous model. Again, the dishwasher does a great job cleaning and drying the dishes. I should have looked more closely at the rack designs and may have attempted to put our old middle rack in the new machine at installation.

Sentence (English): After we discovered that the top sprayer no longer spun in our 24 YO Sears Kenmore dishwasher and that the replacement parts were either extremely expensive or unavailable, we purchased a new Bosch 800 Series diswasher.
Comments (English): [ We love our new Bosch 800! ] || ---------------- || After we discovered that the top sprayer no longer spun in our 24 YO Sears Kenmore dishwasher and that the replacement parts were either extremely expensive or unavailable, we purchased a new Bosch 800 Series diswasher. We love the upper silverware tray which is more versatile and convenient than a silverware basket and less messy. It also frees up more space on the lower rack for larger pots and pans, larger bowls, and casserole dishes. The layout of the tines on both lower and middle racks, fit our glasses, plates, and cereal bowls perfectly, and the ability to lower tines that aren't needed to fit larger items is a plus. The PrecisionWash capability to choose four zones for the lower rack means that pots and casserole dishes can get extra attention. The CrystalDry with zeolite technology means that everything comes out dry, including plastic storage containers. The soap dispenser works much better than our old one which would occasionally and unintentionally be blocked from opening. Also, we no longer rinse our dishes because the Bosch leaves everything sparkling clean, even if we only run the dishwasher every 3-4 days (just two of us). Sentence (English): I am using it so well.
Comments (English): I am using it so well. I should have switched to a larger size sooner. A dishwasher is truly an essential item. The technician was also incredibly kind, which made for a great experience. When I hosted a housewarming party recently, there was a huge pile of dishes after a meal for seven people; however, when I packed them tightly into the #12PlaceDishwasher, all the dishes fit. They came out spotlessly clean, and that’s when I was truly satisfied with the LG dishwasher. It was convenient to be able to handle large loads of dishes all at once. Pros: Convenience: Saves dishwashing time and improves quality of life. Clean design and built-in fit: Blends well with the kitchen. Excellent cleaning power: Removes even greasy residue cleanly. Cons: Price: The initial purchase cost can be a burden. Space taken: It takes up quite a bit of space in the base cabinet, reducing storage capacity. Need to adapt to dish arrangement: It may take some time to load dishes efficiently at first. Overall, the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages. I am so satisfied with the #LGObjetDishwasher that I highly recommend this household item. For a detailed review starting from installation, see below.

Comments (English): [ King of Value Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || My LG dishwasher, which I had been using for over 10 years, frequently stopped mid-cycle, causing me a lot of trouble. Even though it was an old-style model without a steam or automatic opening function, I had used it 2-3 times a day and was very attached to it. To say goodbye to this beloved dishwasher, I looked into LG models by function and size, and I chose one similar to the one I used. I decided on a 12-place setting model without a steam function. With Rocket Installation, I ordered on Sunday and had it installed on Tuesday. When trying to put it in its original spot, the hole was a tight fit, so it seemed I would have to lift the countertop slightly to get it in. I cut and removed the silicone sealant holding the countertop in place with a utility knife, lifted it up, and inserted it. They secured the body well with screws to ensure stability, leveled it, and meticulously ensured there were no leaks in the water inlet pipe connecting from the water supply under the sink bowl. It works well, and the dishes are very clean after washing. If you only put dishes in the top rack when there is a small amount of food... I select the Top Quick Wash and finish in 30 minutes. When I have a lot of dishes in both the top and bottom drawers, I usually use the 1-hour setting. When there are a lot of greasy dishes, I choose the Automatic or Standard course. The dishes are piping hot after washing, so if you leave the door open, the residual heat dries them quickly. There is a timer function, but I rarely use it. It is very attractive in terms of price compared to the latest 14-place setting model, and I am satisfied with choosing the model without the steam function since I don't have baby bottles or other baby items. There is a significant price difference compared to Costco or offline stores, and I like that the installation date was scheduled quickly. I bought my kimchi refrigerator, TV, and dishwasher all on Coupang.

Sentence (English): We had the same brand of dishwasher and actually the same series and I was curious about the difference myself, after all, it takes many years for technology to advance.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We had the same brand of dishwasher and actually the same series and I was curious about the difference myself, after all, it takes many years for technology to advance. And I have to say that I am satisfied. The previous version was also great for that time and I was satisfied, but the progress is noticeable. I like the stoppers that prevent the glasses from moving and since I also put baby bottles in the dishwasher, I appreciate that the stoppers help prevent the teats from turning over and therefore there is no water in them after the program ends. I also appreciate the self-opening door and the fact that I can turn it off/on at will in the settings. The programs are also good, I would say that they are a little longer than with the previous dishwasher, but still in moderation and the dishes are beautifully washed. The only thing I would criticize, but I'm starting to feel like it probably can't be done any better, is that despite drying in the dishwasher, opening the door and leaving it open all night, there are still a few plastic pieces, e.g. the aforementioned bottles with residual water on the outside at the bottom, sometimes also on the inside, so they are not completely dry.
Comments (Original): [ Myčka ] || ---------------- || Předchozí myčku jsme měli stejné značky a vlastně i totožné série a sama jsem byla zvědavá na rozdíl, přeci jen je to řada let na posun v technice. A musím říct, že jsem spokojená. I předchozí verze byla na tu dobu skvělá a byla jsem spokojená, ale pokrok je znát  Líbí se mi zarážky, díky kterým se skleničky neposouvají a protože do myčky dávám i kojenecké lahvičky, tak oceňuji, že zarážky pomáhají neobracení saviček a tedy v nich po ukončení programu nestojí voda. Oceňuji také samootevření dvířek  a to, že si ho můžu libovolně vypnout/zapnout v nastavení. Programy jsou také fajn, řekla bych, že o něco delší než u předchozí myčky, ale pořád v míře a nádobí je pak krásně umyté. Jediné co bych vytkla, ale začínám mít pocit, že to asi lépe prostě udělat nejde, že i přes sušení myčkou, otevření dvířek a ponechání otevřených dvířek celou noc je stejně pár plastových kusů, např. výše zmíněné lahvičky se zbytkovou vodou zvenku na dnu, někdy i zevnitř, tedy nejsou zcela suché.

Sentence (English): I purchased an LG dishwasher along with my move, and to put it simply, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner.
Comments (English): I purchased an LG dishwasher along with my move, and to put it simply, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. The biggest advantage is definitely saving time. I can save almost all the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals. If I just roughly pre-wash them and put them in, they automatically wash and dry them thoroughly, which has drastically reduced my stress regarding housework. In particular, even greasy dishes and pots come out cleaner than expected. The storage structure is also well-designed. Not only plates, cups, and cutlery, but also frying pans and large pots fit in without any difficulty. The loading method feels a bit awkward at first, but after using it a few times, you get the hang of the optimal arrangement, and efficiency increases significantly. Overall, I am satisfied with the cleaning power. Since it uses high temperature washing, it definitely feels hygienic, and almost no water stains or blemishes remain. The drying function works quite well, so it is convenient to be able to take everything out and use it immediately. The noise level is also not as loud as I expected. It is not loud enough to be unnoticed unless you are paying attention, but it is not at a level that interferes with daily life. It is quiet enough that it is not a significant burden even when running at night. The downside is that you need to change your usage habits a little initially. You need to get used to the pattern of gathering dishes and running them all at once instead of washing them immediately. You should also consider that you need to use dishwasher-specific detergent. Overall, it is not just a simple appliance, but an item that definitely improves your quality of life. If you want to reduce the time spent washing dishes, it is well worth the investment.
Comments (Original): 이사하면서 함께 들인 LG 식기세척기, 한마디로 말하면 “왜 이제 샀나 싶을 정도”로 만족스럽다.가장 큰 장점은 확실히 시간 절약이다. 식사 후 설거지에 쓰던 시간을 거의 통째로 아낄 수 있다. 대충 애벌만 해서 넣어두면 알아서 깨끗하게 세척되고 건조까지 되니, 집안일 스트레스가 확 줄었다. 특히 기름기 많은 그릇이나 냄비도 기대 이상으로 깔끔하게 나온다.수납 구조도 잘 설계되어 있다. 접시, 컵, 수저는 물론이고 프라이팬이나 큰 냄비도 무리 없이 들어간다. 처음엔 넣는 방식이 조금 어색하지만 몇 번 쓰다 보면 최적의 배치가 잡혀서 효율이 확 올라간다.세척력은 전반적으로 만족스럽다. 고온 세척이라 위생적인 느낌이 확실히 있고, 물때나 얼룩도 거의 남지 않는다. 건조 기능도 꽤 잘 되는 편이라 바로 꺼내서 사용할 수 있는 점이 편하다.소음도 생각보다 크지 않다. 돌아가는지 신경 쓰지 않으면 모를 정도는 아니지만, 일상생활에 방해될 수준은 아니다. 밤에 돌려도 크게 부담 없는 수준이다.단점이라면 초기에는 사용 습관을 조금 바꿔야 한다는 점이다. 설거지를 바로 하는 대신 모아서 한 번에 돌리는 패턴에 적응이 필요하다. 그리고 식기세척기 전용 세제를 따로 써야 하는 점도 고려해야 한다.총평하면, 단순한 가전이 아니라 삶의 질을 확실히 올려주는 아이템이다. 설거지에 쓰는 시간을 줄이고 싶다면 충분히 투자할 가치가 있다.

Sentence (English): I bought a dishwasher for the first time while moving.
Comments (English): [ It's the best. ] || ---------------- || I bought a dishwasher for the first time while moving. I was concerned about things like the height of the baseboard, but the technician came and adjusted and trimmed it perfectly, resulting in a neat installation. Since it's my first time using it, I'm still unfamiliar with how much food residue to remove before placing dishes and how to stack them so the water doesn't block the drainage, but after running it about five times, it is definitely convenient. I expect it will become even more convenient once I get used to it. I ran it after dinner, and since it operates for about 2 hours and 30 minutes, I was worried about when I would get to sleep or if it would be noisy; however, it operates so quietly that you have to get close to hear the water sound faintly. Also, once I start the dishwasher and do other things, I hear a "ding" sound before I know it, and the door clicks open about 10 minutes later, which is great because I don't have to worry about it. I rarely use the hot air drying function; I just remove the rack to let the dishes dry overnight. Since I don't use fabric softener, some water droplets remain, but I don't really mind them. If that bothers you, you can simply use fabric softener. With a family of three including a toddler, I was worried the 14-place setting might be a bit too big, but I bought it based on the saying "the bigger, the better." Sentence (English): I purchased an LG dishwasher along with my move, and to put it simply, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner.
Comments (English): I purchased an LG dishwasher along with my move, and to put it simply, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. The biggest advantage is definitely saving time. I can save almost all the time I used to spend washing dishes after meals. If I just roughly pre-wash them and put them in, they automatically clean and dry them, which has drastically reduced my stress regarding housework. In particular, even greasy dishes and pots come out cleaner than expected. The storage structure is also well-designed. Not only plates, cups, and cutlery, but also frying pans and large pots fit in without any difficulty. The loading method feels a bit awkward at first, but after using it a few times, you get the optimal layout, and efficiency increases significantly. Overall, I am satisfied with the cleaning power. Since it washes at a high temperature, it definitely feels hygienic, and almost no water stains or blemishes remain. The drying function works quite well, so it is convenient to be able to take items out and use them immediately. The noise level is also not as loud as I expected. It is not loud enough to be unnoticed unless you are paying attention, but it is not at a level that interferes with daily life. It is quiet enough that it is not a significant burden even when running at night. The only downside is that you need to adjust your usage habits a little in the beginning. You need to get used to the pattern of gathering dishes and running them all at once instead of washing them immediately. You also need to consider that you must use dishwasher-specific detergent. Overall, it is not just a simple appliance, but an item that definitely improves your quality of life. If you want to reduce the time spent on washing dishes, it is well worth the investment.

Sentence (English): We selected this model because of its size, reputation, appearance, and the water-leak sensor.
Comments (English): [ A+ ] || ---------------- || We selected this model because of its size, reputation, appearance, and the water-leak sensor. The appliance does an excellent job cleaning dishes (see photos). Our tap water is heated to 126ºF (120-149ºF recommended) which seems good enough. We were additionally pleased by the top third rack that accommodates difficult-to-place items like spatulas, lifters, and cooking spoons. The dishwasher is so quiet, that the manufacturer added both a digital count-down timer, and a subtle undulating floor light as signs that the dishwasher is running and how much longer is left in the cycle. This machine is quieter (42 db) than a clothes dryer. The unit offers a variety of cleaning & drying options. The chime signalling that the door is automatically opening to release steam at the end of the cycle is an unexpected nice feature. An adhesive aluminum strip is provided to protect cabinetry and countertop from the steam (photo.) The controls at the top of the door are easily used. The paper & online manuals contain tips that improved our operation & appreciation for the appliance. Wifi is not required to operate the appliance, though additional features are offered.

Sentence (English): Reason for Purchase: I generally enjoy washing dishes, but since it takes over an hour, it puts a strain on my wrists and back, so I started looking into dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Cost-effective dishwasher with automatic door opening function ] || ---------------- || Reason for Purchase: I generally enjoy washing dishes, but since it takes over an hour, it puts a strain on my wrists and back, so I started looking into dishwashers. I was concerned about moisture remaining inside if the door isn't opened immediately after use, so I chose a model with an automatic door opening function. Since it was a model without a hot air drying function, the price was lower, and I found it to be quite inconvenient to use. Referring to other reviews, the fact that even with the hot air drying function, standing water doesn't dry completely also influenced my decision. Installation Process: Generally, it is said that the wall construction and installation can be completed together on a designated date. However, in my case, installation was only possible in the space under the induction cooktop, and since the kitchen layout had been modified, we proceeded with a pre-inspection first. The standard procedure is pre-inspection, induction cooktop elevation, wall construction, and dishwasher installation; however, since we planned to handle the elevation ourselves and had the materials prepared in advance, we proceeded with the elevation separately after the wall construction. Depending on the kitchen structure, the difficulty, duration, and additional costs of the construction may vary, but for standard cabinets, it is said to be done at no extra cost. Installation Satisfaction: The dishwasher installer was very meticulous and kind. It felt like all the stress I experienced during the installation process vanished. Since there is no separate place to leave a review, I am leaving my thanks here. Ease of Use: The control buttons are hidden when the door is closed, and I am actually more satisfied because the clean appearance makes it look neat. The ability to configure settings via my phone is also convenient, and I currently mainly use the Bixby function. It felt much more convenient than using my phone when my hands were wet. After trying various features, I have settled on using the AI custom course with an added rinse cycle. Detergent Usage: After trying two types of Frosh tablet detergents and a powder detergent from another brand, I found the Frosh products to be generally more satisfying. Since I used Pril Secret Of Baking Soda Pure Lemon scent for the pre-wash, I didn't notice a significant difference between the two Frosh detergents, and it seems fine to choose the cheaper product depending on the situation. Pril dish soap was effective for removing fishy odors even when I used it for hand washing; however, there were times when odors remained when I pre-washed with just water. I am satisfied with using it because the odor does not linger after pre-washing with Pril. I am currently using a conditioner from another brand, but I am not very satisfied with it, so I plan to switch to Frosh products in the future. Since this is an expensive product, other people's reviews were very helpful to me when I was considering purchasing it. I decided to leave a slightly more detailed review in case it might be of help to others as well. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you could click 'Helpful'. ^^

Comments (English): [ Cost-effective dishwasher with automatic door opening function ] || ---------------- || Reason for Purchase: I generally enjoy washing dishes, but since it takes over an hour, it puts a strain on my wrists and back, so I started looking into dishwashers. I was concerned about moisture remaining inside if the door isn't opened immediately after use, so I chose a model with an automatic door opening function. Since it was a model without a hot air drying function, the price was lower, and I found it to be quite inconvenient to use. Referring to other reviews, the fact that even with the hot air drying function, standing water doesn't dry completely also influenced my decision. Installation Process: Generally, it is said that the wall construction and installation can be completed together on a designated date. However, in my case, installation was only possible in the space under the induction cooktop, and since the kitchen layout had been modified, we proceeded with a pre-inspection first. The standard procedure is pre-inspection, induction cooktop elevation, wall construction, and dishwasher installation; however, since we planned to handle the elevation ourselves and had the materials prepared in advance, we proceeded with the elevation separately after the wall construction. Depending on the kitchen structure, the difficulty, duration, and additional costs of the construction may vary, but for standard cabinets, it is said to be done at no extra cost. Installation Satisfaction: The dishwasher installer was very meticulous and kind. It felt like all the stress I experienced during the installation process vanished. Since there is no separate place to leave a review, I am leaving my thanks here. Ease of Use: The control buttons are hidden when the door is closed, and I am actually more satisfied because the clean appearance makes it look neat. The ability to configure settings via my phone is also convenient, and I currently mainly use the Bixby function. It felt much more convenient than using my phone when my hands were wet. After trying various features, I have settled on using the AI custom course with an added rinse cycle. Detergent Usage: After trying two types of Frosh tablet detergents and a powder detergent from another brand, I found the Frosh products to be generally more satisfying. Since I used Pril Secret Of Baking Soda Pure Lemon scent for the pre-wash, I didn't notice a significant difference between the two Frosh detergents, and it seems fine to choose the cheaper product depending on the situation. Comments (English): [ Cost-effective dishwasher with automatic door opening function ] || ---------------- || Reason for Purchase: I generally enjoy washing dishes, but since it takes over an hour, it puts a strain on my wrists and back, so I started looking into dishwashers. I was concerned about moisture remaining inside if the door isn't opened immediately after use, so I chose a model with an automatic door opening function. Since it was a model without a hot air drying function, the price was lower, and I found it to be quite inconvenient to use. Referring to other reviews, the fact that even with the hot air drying function, standing water doesn't dry completely also influenced my decision. Installation Process: Generally, it is said that the wall construction and installation can be completed together on a designated date. However, in my case, installation was only possible in the space under the induction cooktop, and since the kitchen layout had been modified, we proceeded with a pre-inspection first. The standard procedure is pre-inspection, induction cooktop elevation, wall construction, and dishwasher installation; however, since we planned to handle the elevation ourselves and had the materials prepared in advance, we proceeded with the elevation separately after the wall construction. Depending on the kitchen structure, the difficulty, duration, and additional costs of the construction may vary, but for standard cabinets, it is said to be done at no extra cost. Installation Satisfaction: The dishwasher installer was very meticulous and kind. It felt like all the stress I experienced during the installation process vanished. Since there is no separate place to leave a review, I am leaving my thanks here. Ease of Use: The control buttons are hidden when the door is closed, and I am actually more satisfied because the clean appearance makes it look neat. The ability to configure settings via my phone is also convenient, and I currently mainly use the Bixby function. It felt much more convenient than using my phone when my hands were wet. After trying various features, I have settled on using the AI custom course with an added rinse cycle. Detergent Usage: After trying two types of Frosh tablet detergents and a powder detergent from another brand, I found the Frosh products to be generally more satisfying. Since I used Pril Secret Of Baking Soda Pure Lemon scent for the pre-wash, I didn't notice a significant difference between the two Frosh detergents, and it seems fine to choose the cheaper product depending on the situation. Pril dish soap was effective for removing fishy odors even when I used it for hand washing; however, there were times when odors remained when I pre-washed with just water. I am satisfied with using it because the odor does not linger after pre-washing with Pril. I am currently using a conditioner from another brand, but I am not very satisfied with it, so I plan to switch to Frosh products in the future. Since this is an expensive product, other people's reviews were very helpful to me when I was considering purchasing it. I decided to leave a slightly more detailed review in case it might be of help to others as well. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you could click 'Helpful'. ^^

Since it was a model without a hot air drying function, the price was lower, and I found it to be quite inconvenient to use. Referring to other reviews, the fact that even with the hot air drying function, standing water doesn't dry completely also influenced my decision. Installation Process: Generally, it is said that the wall construction and installation can be completed together on a designated date. However, in my case, installation was only possible in the space under the induction cooktop, and since the kitchen layout had been modified, we proceeded with a pre-inspection first. The standard procedure is pre-inspection, induction cooktop elevation, wall construction, and dishwasher installation; however, since we planned to handle the elevation ourselves and had the materials prepared in advance, we proceeded with the elevation separately after the wall construction. Depending on the kitchen structure, the difficulty, duration, and additional costs of the construction may vary, but for standard cabinets, it is said to be done at no extra cost. Installation Satisfaction: The dishwasher installer was very meticulous and kind. It felt like all the stress I experienced during the installation process vanished. Since there is no separate place to leave a review, I am leaving my thanks here. Ease of Use: The control buttons are hidden when the door is closed, and I am actually more satisfied because the clean appearance makes it look neat. The ability to configure settings via my phone is also convenient, and I currently mainly use the Bixby function. It felt much more convenient than using my phone when my hands were wet. After trying various features, I have settled on using the AI custom course with an added rinse cycle. Detergent Usage: After trying two types of Frosh tablet detergents and a powder detergent from another brand, I found the Frosh products to be generally more satisfying. Since I used Pril Secret Of Baking Soda Pure Lemon scent for the pre-wash, I didn't notice a significant difference between the two Frosh detergents, and it seems fine to choose the cheaper product depending on the situation. Pril dish soap was effective for removing fishy odors even when I used it for hand washing; however, there were times when odors remained when I pre-washed with just water. I am satisfied with using it because the odor does not linger after pre-washing with Pril. I am currently using a conditioner from another brand, but I am not very satisfied with it, so I plan to switch to Frosh products in the future. Since this is an expensive product, other people's reviews were very helpful to me when I was considering purchasing it. Comments (English): [ Cost-effective dishwasher with automatic door opening function ] || ---------------- || Reason for Purchase: I generally enjoy washing dishes, but since it takes over an hour, it puts a strain on my wrists and back, so I started looking into dishwashers. I was concerned about moisture remaining inside if the door isn't opened immediately after use, so I chose a model with an automatic door opening function. Since it was a model without a hot air drying function, the price was lower, and I found it to be quite inconvenient to use. Referring to other reviews, the fact that even with the hot air drying function, standing water doesn't dry completely also influenced my decision. Installation Process: Generally, it is said that the wall construction and installation can be completed together on a designated date. However, in my case, installation was only possible in the space under the induction cooktop, and since the kitchen layout had been modified, we proceeded with a pre-inspection first. The standard procedure is pre-inspection, induction cooktop elevation, wall construction, and dishwasher installation; however, since we planned to handle the elevation ourselves and had the materials prepared in advance, we proceeded with the elevation separately after the wall construction. Depending on the kitchen structure, the difficulty, duration, and additional costs of the construction may vary, but for standard cabinets, it is said to be done at no extra cost. Installation Satisfaction: The dishwasher installer was very meticulous and kind. It felt like all the stress I experienced during the installation process vanished. Since there is no separate place to leave a review, I am leaving my thanks here. Ease of Use: The control buttons are hidden when the door is closed, and I am actually more satisfied because the clean appearance makes it look neat. The ability to configure settings via my phone is also convenient, and I currently mainly use the Bixby function. It felt much more convenient than using my phone when my hands were wet. After trying various features, I have settled on using the AI custom course with an added rinse cycle. Detergent Usage: After trying two types of Frosh tablet detergents and a powder detergent from another brand, I found the Frosh products to be generally more satisfying. Since I used Pril Secret Of Baking Soda Pure Lemon scent for the pre-wash, I didn't notice a significant difference between the two Frosh detergents, and it seems fine to choose the cheaper product depending on the situation. Pril dish soap was effective for removing fishy odors even when I used it for hand washing; however, there were times when odors remained when I pre-washed with just water. I am satisfied with using it because the odor does not linger after pre-washing with Pril. I am currently using a conditioner from another brand, but I am not very satisfied with it, so I plan to switch to Frosh products in the future. Since this is an expensive product, other people's reviews were very helpful to me when I was considering purchasing it. I decided to leave a slightly more detailed review in case it might be of help to others as well. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you could click 'Helpful'. ^^

Since it was a model without a hot air drying function, the price was lower, and I found it to be quite inconvenient to use. Referring to other reviews, the fact that even with the hot air drying function, standing water doesn't dry completely also influenced my decision. Installation Process: Generally, it is said that the wall construction and installation can be completed together on a designated date. However, in my case, installation was only possible in the space under the induction cooktop, and since the kitchen layout had been modified, we proceeded with a pre-inspection first. The standard procedure is pre-inspection, induction cooktop elevation, wall construction, and dishwasher installation; however, since we planned to handle the elevation ourselves and had the materials prepared in advance, we proceeded with the elevation separately after the wall construction. Depending on the kitchen structure, the difficulty, duration, and additional costs of the construction may vary, but for standard cabinets, it is said to be done at no extra cost. Installation Satisfaction: The dishwasher installer was very meticulous and kind. It felt like all the stress I experienced during the installation process vanished. Since there is no separate place to leave a review, I am leaving my thanks here. Ease of Use: The control buttons are hidden when the door is closed, and I am actually more satisfied because the clean appearance makes it look neat. The ability to configure settings via my phone is also convenient, and I currently mainly use the Bixby function. It felt much more convenient than using my phone when my hands were wet. After trying various features, I have settled on using the AI custom course with an added rinse cycle. Detergent Usage: After trying two types of Frosh tablet detergents and a powder detergent from another brand, I found the Frosh products to be generally more satisfying. Since I used Pril Secret Of Baking Soda Pure Lemon scent for the pre-wash, I didn't notice a significant difference between the two Frosh detergents, and it seems fine to choose the cheaper product depending on the situation. Pril dish soap was effective for removing fishy odors even when I used it for hand washing; however, there were times when odors remained when I pre-washed with just water. I am satisfied with using it because the odor does not linger after pre-washing with Pril. I am currently using a conditioner from another brand, but I am not very satisfied with it, so I plan to switch to Frosh products in the future. Since this is an expensive product, other people's reviews were very helpful to me when I was considering purchasing it. I decided to leave a slightly more detailed review in case it might be of help to others as well. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you could click 'Helpful'. ^^

Sentence (English): I want to love this super quiet dishwasher, but I have found two flaws that I felt I should share.
Comments (English): [ Beware of Sharp Edges! ] || ---------------- || I want to love this super quiet dishwasher, but I have found two flaws that I felt I should share. First, beware of a sharp metal edge inside the rack. When extended the metal is exposed and unfortunately, I cut my finger removing a glass. See the circled area in photo. Secondly, the bottom rack is a problem because the rubber seal on the right side is not aligned properly. I constantly have to push harder than normal to get the rack in place. The seal catches on the cutlery basket. As a result, I don't take the basket out to empty since getting it in place again is a pain. This is disappointing. I selected this dishwasher because of the low decibel level which is outstanding. Had I been aware of the issues described I would have selected a different dishwasher. I cannot recommend this one.

Sentence (English): Hello.
Comments (English): Hello. I’d like to leave a review of the LG Electronics DIOS Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher (12-place setting). When the technician arrived, seeing him meticulously level the unit to ensure there were no gaps or awkward-looking gaps since it is a built-in model, I was reminded once again of the trust that LG truly makes the best home appliances. Since it is a 12-place setting model, the capacity is very generous, making it sufficient for households with children like ours to handle the mountains of dishes that pile up after just one day. In the past, I used to struggle in front of the sink for a long time after dinner, leaving little time to talk with my child and causing back pain. Now that I just need to do a light pre-wash and put the dishes away, I realize every night that my quality of life has skyrocketed. In particular, the interior structure, which allows even large pots and pans to fit right in, is truly practical. I was also really surprised by the cleaning power; on days when I grilled greasy pork belly or dishes with burnt-on sauce, using the True Steam function made them squeaky clean compared to washing by hand. They came out polished to a shine. Knowing that it even offers high-temperature sterilization gives me much greater peace of mind when using it on my children's tableware. Since the door automatically opens to release internal moisture once drying is finished, I can maintain hygiene without worrying about odors. I am most satisfied with the fact that I can keep things hygienically maintained. That pleasant warmth and fluffiness felt when taking out the dried dishes is a happiness that only those who have experienced it can understand. It was such a worthwhile choice that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner, as having known that just one appliance would increase the time I can spend with my family and give me peace of mind. It is perfect in every aspect—design, performance, and even installation satisfaction—so I would like to recommend it to anyone considering kitchen appliances.

Sentence (English): I used to use a 6-place setting dishwasher, but switching to a 12-place setting is definitely a whole new world.
Comments (English): [ I used a 6-person one, but replaced it with a 12-person one when I moved. ] || ---------------- || I used to use a 6-place setting dishwasher, but switching to a 12-place setting is definitely a whole new world. I made a big decision to upgrade when I moved, and I am using it so well that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner! 1. Capacity. When I used the 6-place setting model, it would fill up completely with just one pot, so I ended up doing hand washing as well. But since this is a 12-place setting, it fits perfectly into a built-in unit, and the interior space is really spacious. It is enough to run a whole day's worth of dishes at once, and since large pots and pans fit in all at once, I can get off the kitchen much faster! 2. Performance and Cleaning Power. As expected from an LG Objet, the cleaning power is better than I expected. Even if I put in dishes after a quick pre-wash, they come out squeaky clean with not a single trace of grease. It is also intuitive to operate, so it is convenient enough that even my parents can use it right away when they visit. 3. Design. The Nature Beige color is really pretty! It instantly brightens up the kitchen atmosphere and looks luxurious, so it is definitely adding to the interior decor. The noise is also quieter than I expected, so I can leave it running at night while I sleep without it bothering me at all. If you are debating which dishwasher to buy, definitely go for the 12-place setting one instead of the 6-place setting. It is truly the best! I highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): I used an LG Dios dishwasher for over 10 years, but every time I ran a wash cycle, I would smell something like a burning engine.
Comments (English): [ It's great that there is a separate space for solid detergent! ] || ---------------- || I used an LG Dios dishwasher for over 10 years, but every time I ran a wash cycle, I would smell something like a burning engine. So, instead of getting it repaired, I recently purchased a new Objet. Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!
