Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

Comments (English): [ It's great that there is a separate space for solid detergent! ] || ---------------- || I used an LG Dios dishwasher for over 10 years, but every time I ran a wash cycle, I would smell something like a burning engine. So, instead of getting it repaired, I recently purchased a new Objet. Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

Comments (English): [ It's great that there is a separate space for solid detergent! ] || ---------------- || I used an LG Dios dishwasher for over 10 years, but every time I ran a wash cycle, I would smell something like a burning engine. So, instead of getting it repaired, I recently purchased a new Objet. Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

Comments (English): [ It's great that there is a separate space for solid detergent! ] || ---------------- || I used an LG Dios dishwasher for over 10 years, but every time I ran a wash cycle, I would smell something like a burning engine. So, instead of getting it repaired, I recently purchased a new Objet. Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

Comments (English): [ It's great that there is a separate space for solid detergent! ] || ---------------- || I used an LG Dios dishwasher for over 10 years, but every time I ran a wash cycle, I would smell something like a burning engine. So, instead of getting it repaired, I recently purchased a new Objet. Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

Comments (English): [ It's great that there is a separate space for solid detergent! ] || ---------------- || I used an LG Dios dishwasher for over 10 years, but every time I ran a wash cycle, I would smell something like a burning engine. So, instead of getting it repaired, I recently purchased a new Objet. Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

Although some members of my family use SK products, I feel that LG dishwashers are sturdily built, and I am writing this review to help others with their purchase. I hope my review will be of some help to those who have to make a decision based on reviews without actually using the product. I also buy a lot from Coupang; since I can't see or use the product in person before buying, I found reading other people's reviews very helpful before making a purchase. First of all, I am very satisfied with the advantage of "Rocket Installation." Even though I live in a rural area, it was installed the very next day, and I was able to coordinate the installation schedule and time with the technician, which I really appreciate. You have probably experienced appliance installations taking a long time just because you live in a rural area. Rocket Installation was fast, and an LG specialist technician came and installed it in detail, even providing explanations! 1) First, I purchased the freestanding model. Since I previously used a 12-place setting dishwasher, I removed the countertop and installed it by placing the unit directly into the sink. Although the freestanding model was slightly more expensive than the built-in one, I purchased the freestanding version because the baseboards had already been cut. I installed it by detaching the countertop! 2) I checked the dimensions of the 12-place and 14-place models, and they are identical. If your dishwasher cabinet is set up based on the 12-place model, I think the 14-place model will fit well as well. However, actual measurements can vary on-site, so please check this in advance. 3) Modern dishwashers have a separate compartment for solid detergent. With my previous dishwasher, the solid detergent would stick to the dispenser and wouldn't dissolve properly, so I just threw it in to use it. It is convenient to have a designated spot for solid detergent as shown in the picture. 4) I was advised to add fabric softener before adding detergent if water stains become severe. Although I am using a detergent that doubles as fabric softener, I plan to pour in the softener if water stains appear. They say that just like the automatic detergent dispenser in a washing machine, once you pour in the softener, it will dispense automatically for about a month. 5) Modern dishwashers come with a hot air drying feature. Since they dry dishes using hot air like a hair dryer, I heard you need to replace the filter once a year. I also heard that it sucks up all the dust from the surroundings. There is a filter slot at the bottom of the dishwasher, and since it is a simple replacement, anyone can do it. At first, I didn't use it much because I wondered how well it cleaned and if it would be too quick for my hands, but now I feel like I can't live without it. It really allows me to escape the hell of dishwashing and use appliances conveniently and cleanly; it truly changes my quality of life. When it comes to motor-driven appliances, it has to be LG. It reminds me of what the elders used to say: if you're going to buy appliances, you should always get the latest model. I am satisfied; everything is perfect, from the installation to the design!

Very quiet except when using the storm wash you may hear it a little bit but still pretty quiet, and our kitchen is only about 25' from our bedroom and it does not bother us at all. The only complaint is that the racks could be a little more sturdy or the slides could be better. Our old dishwasher the racks slid out easily and smoothly, this one not so good if you have delicate glasses or wine glasses you need to use both hands and slide it carefully otherwise you may risk broken glasses or cups. Other than than a good dishwasher.

Sentence (English): A technician came to give an installation quote, a sink technician came the next day to do the cabinet work (80,000 KRW), and another technician came the day after that to complete the dishwasher installation.
Comments (English): [ I installed it and am using it. ] || ---------------- || A technician came to give an installation quote, a sink technician came the next day to do the cabinet work (80,000 KRW), and another technician came the day after that to complete the dishwasher installation. It used to be a hassle to cut the cabinet, take out all the stored dishes, and reorganize them, but it is so convenient not having to do the dishes anymore. It used to be so hard to spend an hour washing the piled-up dishes after work, but it is great that the dishwasher does it for me. The coating on the cabinet doors started peeling off a little while they were cutting. The gap between the baseboard and the dishwasher is also unsightly. I don't mind because I plan to apply a film, but I think it might bother those who don't. Additional installation fees apply depending on the installation environment; for me, it cost a total of 122,000 KRW. Everything is great, but after the dishwasher was installed, the sink drain pipe started making a gurgling sound, so I am worried as I am currently working with the technician to find a solution.
Comments (Original): [ 설치 받아서 사용 중입니다. ] || ---------------- || 기사님 오셔서 설치견적 내시고 다음날 씽크기사님 오셔서 장공사(80,000)해주시고 그다음날 다시 기사님 와서 식기세척기 설치완료 했어요..씽크대 자르고 수납됐던 식기류 다 꺼냈다 다시 정리하고 힘들었는데 설거지 안하니 너무 편하네요.일하고 와서 쌓여있는 설거지 한시간씩 하려면 너무 힘들었는데 식세기가 대신 해주니 너무 좋아요.씽크대문짝 자르며 코팅이 조금씩 벗겨지더라구요.걸레받이랑 식세기사이 틈도 보기 흉하긴 해요.저는 필름시공예정이라 개의치 않지만 아닌분들은 신경 쓰일거 같아요.설치환경에 따라 설치비가 추가됩니다,저는 총122.000원 들어갔네요.다 좋은데 식세기 설치 후 씽크대배수관에서 꾸륵꾸륵 소리가 나서 기사님과 문제해결방법 찾고 있는데 걱정이네요.

There is an innovative feature on this dishwasher that makes complete sense in drying and saving power. This unit has a feature called AutoVent Dry that opens the washer when the wash cycle is done and allows steam to escape from the door while the fan air dry's the dishes. This works pretty well and take about 30 mins of so to dry. This feature I feel helps keep the washer fresh and decreases the chance of mildew building up.The other innovative feature is the smart app. It uses LG's ThinQ. I like that the app reminds me when to clean the dishwasher and as well as show me how many Kwh of energy is being used. The app also allows to download different cycles that aren't shown on the control panel on the dishwasher.There is also a feature where there is a light that illuminates when a cycle is running. It's a nice visual cue letting me know when the machine is on.And a small upgrade would be the rubber seal around the dishwasher. This keeps steam from getting behind the washer and it makes the dishwasher fit into the countertop space.I installed this unit myself. The instructions were very clear and easy to follow.Overall – This is a nice dishwasher

Sentence (English): My kitchen is so small, but I really wanted to use a dishwasher.

I felt like dishes wouldn't wash well if they were stacked, so I tried putting them in spaced out, but it didn't seem like many would fit. Unfortunately, the link provided in the user manual and by the AI both went to the general product page and had no information on leaks. I asked the AI for a PDF of the leak guide instead, and it got confused and started the process over again asking me which product I needed help with.I'm contacting Costco and I'm going to buy something other than a Samsung. Again, the people at Costco are awesome. Samsung? Not so much.

Sentence (English): As a family of three, the 6-place setting was sometimes too small to fit large pots or pans, so I switched to an LG 12-place setting.
Comments (English): [ I switched from using an SK 6-person unit. ] || ---------------- || As a family of three, the 6-place setting was sometimes too small to fit large pots or pans, so I switched to an LG 12-place setting. However, I would like to list a few disappointing points. (I did not use the drying function due to the electricity bill.) When running in normal mode, the display shows that it takes over five hours from door opening to natural drying. Yet, even after six hours, dishes and cups that are deep or have rims are still soaked with water. The SK dishwasher I used before did not have a drying function, but over 95% of the dishes would be dry after about two hours. Now, I have to pre-wash, run the dishwasher, and then wipe the water off the dishes (excluding plates). It feels like I have more work now. The second issue is the smell. About two months after purchasing it, I was surprised to hear a fishy smell coming from the dishwasher—was it pork? Or egg? I usually pre-wash thoroughly, and since it is a 12-place setting, I am running it less often than I did with the 6-place setting. However, the smell persisted, so I searched online and found that running the sterilization cycle would solve the problem. The smell went away after adding vinegar and running the sterilization cycle. I am puzzled because the previous one I used for two and a half years never had this problem. Thirdly, the basket makes it inconvenient to arrange dishes. Also, while this isn't a problem with the dishwasher itself, the 12-place setting size is a bit awkward for a family of three. Often, the basket isn't even half full after a meal, so it is inconvenient that I can't run it immediately. I feel like it would have been better to just use the 6-place setting model, even if it was a bit lacking. But I guess it can't be helped. Still, the design is pretty, and the installation was done well.

Sentence (English): The Bosch Series 4 (SMV4ECX28E) exceeds my expectations, especially in terms of drying performance and ease of use.
Comments (English): [ Beautiful drying results and wonderfully quiet ] || ---------------- || The Bosch Series 4 (SMV4ECX28E) exceeds my expectations, especially in terms of drying performance and ease of use. If you are looking for a dishwasher that simply does what it promises, then this is a bullseye. Why I give 5 stars: • EfficientDry (Automatic door opening): This is the biggest win for me. At the end of the program, the door automatically springs open. As a result, the dishes (even plastic containers) air dry much better, and the machine always smells fresh. • Flex baskets and VarioLade: The layout is very flexible. The cutlery drawer at the top saves a huge amount of space in the bottom basket, allowing me to fit large pots and plates without any problems. • Home Connect: I initially thought an app was unnecessary, but it is incredibly handy to receive a notification on my phone when the tablets are running low or when the program is finished. • Silence: At 42 decibels, I can barely hear it running in my open kitchen. The red light on the floor (InfoLight) is therefore essential to see if it is still running. Conclusion: A very solid German machine that combines modern convenience with a sparkling clean result. The price-quality ratio of this Series 4 is simply excellent. Absolutely recommended for every household!
Comments (Original): [ Prachtige droogresultaten en heerlijk stil ] || ---------------- || De Bosch Serie 4 (SMV4ECX28E) overtreft mijn verwachtingen, zeker op het gebied van droogprestaties en gebruiksgemak. Als je op zoek bent naar een vaatwasser die simpelweg doet wat hij belooft, dan is dit een schot in de roos.Waarom ik 5 sterren geef:• EfficientDry (Automatische deuropening): Dit is voor mij de grootste winst. Aan het einde van het programma springt de deur automatisch op een kier. Hierdoor droogt de vaat (zelfs plastic bakjes) veel beter aan de lucht en ruikt de machine altijd fris.• Flex-korven en VarioLade: De indeling is zeer flexibel. De besteklade bovenin bespaart enorm veel ruimte in de onderste korf, waardoor ik probleemloos grote pannen en borden kwijt kan.• Home Connect: Ik dacht eerst dat een app overbodig was, maar het is ontzettend handig om een melding op mijn telefoon te krijgen wanneer de tabletten bijna op zijn of wanneer het programma klaar is.• Stilte: Met 42 decibel hoor ik hem nauwelijks draaien in mijn open keuken. Het rode lichtpunt op de vloer (InfoLight) is dan ook essentieel om te zien of hij nog bezig is.Conclusie:Een zeer degelijke, Duitse machine die modern gemak combineert met een blinkend schoon resultaat. De prijs-kwaliteitverhouding van deze Serie 4 is simpelweg uitstekend. Absoluut een aanrader voor elk huishouden!

Sentence (English): Our dishwasher from a competitor's brand recently malfunction and left our kitchen floor, cabinets, wall and the basement ceiling, wall and floor under our kitchen with extensive water damage.
Comments (English): [ Sleek and modern ] || ---------------- || Our dishwasher from a competitor's brand recently malfunctioned and left our kitchen floor, cabinets, wall and the basement ceiling, wall and floor under our kitchen with extensive water damage. Needless to say we weren't going with that brand again. We previously switched out that brand for a GE range and a GE over-the-range microwave and had great things to say about those. We decided to go with this GE dishwasher. The machine itself is sleek and modern. I love that the handle matches the range and microwave. The inside is also stainless and the 3-tier racks provide ample room for daily dishes. I appreciate that the compartment for the dishwasher pod is not in a spot that will get caught on a rack and not open, as this was a common problem with our previous model. The racks don't seem to slide as easily as I would expect, but they work well enough. The other downfall is the length of each cycle. They are REALLY long. 3-4 hours for a wash, rinse and dry! The one thing that redeems that is the fact that this machine is whisper quiet when running. It also has delay start for up to 12 hours ahead of time, which I use daily as we ru ours in the middle of the night. The buttons are hidden on the top panel, adding to the sleek modernness of the design. Overall I am pleased with this machine. Everything has come out clean and mostly dry. This does not come with a physical instruction manual, fyi, and must be downloaded online.

Sentence (English): This LG dishwasher is truly amazing!
Comments (English): [ Quick & Clean dishes ] || ---------------- || This LG dishwasher is truly amazing! It looks impressive w/ its clean print proof stainless steel front & a seamless top control panel. The stainless steel interior is SO thoughtfully designed w/ more than ample space to accommodate dishes for large families & friends. I also like the flexibility of both the top rack & 2nd row that easily adjust thru side slides further maximizing needed space. As for the 'Smart' features, the LG ThinQ technology keeps You connected through Smart Access & Smart Adapt so You to remote monitor your dishwasher, download the newest cycles. Also through the ThinQ app, You can even remote start your dishwasher. Oh Life IS Good!

Sentence (English): As a family of three, the 6-8 place setting was sometimes too small to fit large pots, pans, or cutting boards, so I upgraded to an LG 12-place setting model.
Comments (English): [ I switched from using an SK 6-person unit. ] || ---------------- || As a family of three, the 6-8 place setting was sometimes too small to fit large pots, pans, or cutting boards, so I upgraded to an LG 12-place setting model. However, I would like to list a few disappointing points. (I did not use the drying function due to the electricity bill.) When running in normal mode, it indicates that it takes over five hours from door opening to natural drying, but even after six hours, dishes and cups with deep sides or rims are still soaked with water. The SK dishwasher I used before did not have a drying function, but over 95% of the dishes would be dry about two hours after finishing. Now, if I pre-wash, run the dishwasher in normal mode, and then wipe the water off the dishes (excluding plates), it feels like there is actually more work involved. The second issue is the smell. About two months after purchasing it, I was surprised to hear a fishy smell—like pork or eggs?—coming up from the dishwasher. I usually pre-wash thoroughly, and since it is a 12-place setting, I run the dishwasher less often than I did with the 6-place setting, but the smell persisted, so I searched online and found... It is actually listed in the related search results. They say you just need to put in vinegar and run the sterilization cycle. The smell did go away after I ran the sterilization cycle, but... I am puzzled because the one I used before, even though I used it for two and a half years, never had these problems. I asked an acquaintance who bought the same dishwasher two years before me about these two issues, and they said it is the same for them. The third issue is the water dripping onto the kitchen floor when pre-washing and storing dishes. Also, while this isn't a problem with the dishwasher itself, the 12-place setting is a bit awkward for a family of three. It is inconvenient that I can't wash dishes immediately after a meal because the baskets often don't even fill halfway. (There is a function to wash only the top rack, but if I have pots or pans, I have to lower them to the second level to store them.) Furthermore, there are pots or dishes that are exactly needed for the next meal, but they end up in the dishwasher unwashed, making them useless. Of course, for those who cook a lot and have generous portions, the 6-8 place setting is quite insufficient. However, I tend to use small pots and pans, and... I really dislike letting the dishes pile up, so I think using the 6-person capacity, even if it's a bit lacking, was the right choice. It can't be helped. If I could have gone back in time, I probably wouldn't have made this unnecessary expense. Still, the design is pretty, and the technician did a great job with the installation.

Sentence (English): I asked an acquaintance who bought the same dishwasher two years before me about these two issues, and they said it is the same for them.
Comments (English): [ I switched from using an SK 6-person unit. ] || ---------------- || As a family of three, the 6-8 place setting was sometimes too small to fit large pots, pans, or cutting boards, so I upgraded to an LG 12-place setting model. However, I would like to list a few disappointing points. (I did not use the drying function due to the electricity bill.) When running in normal mode, it indicates that it takes over five hours from door opening to natural drying, but even after six hours, dishes and cups with deep sides or rims are still soaked with water. The SK dishwasher I used before did not have a drying function, but over 95% of the dishes would be dry about two hours after finishing. Now, if I pre-wash, run the dishwasher in normal mode, and then wipe the water off the dishes (excluding plates), it feels like there is actually more work involved. The second issue is the smell. About two months after purchasing it, I was surprised to hear a fishy smell—like pork or eggs?—coming up from the dishwasher. I usually pre-wash thoroughly, and since it is a 12-place setting, I run the dishwasher less often than I did with the 6-place setting, but the smell persisted, so I searched online and found... It is actually listed in the related search results. They say you just need to put in vinegar and run the sterilization cycle. The smell did go away after I ran the sterilization cycle, but... I am puzzled because the one I used before, even though I used it for two and a half years, never had these problems. I asked an acquaintance who bought the same dishwasher two years before me about these two issues, and they said it is the same for them. The third issue is the water dripping onto the kitchen floor when pre-washing and storing dishes. Also, while this isn't a problem with the dishwasher itself, the 12-place setting is a bit awkward for a family of three. It is inconvenient that I can't wash dishes immediately after a meal because the baskets often don't even fill halfway. (There is a function to wash only the top rack, but if I have pots or pans, I have to lower them to the second level to store them.) Furthermore, there are pots or dishes that are exactly needed for the next meal, but they end up in the dishwasher unwashed, making them useless. Of course, for those who cook a lot and have generous portions, the 6-8 place setting is quite insufficient. However, I tend to use small pots and pans, and... I really dislike letting the dishes pile up, so I think using the 6-person capacity, even if it's a bit lacking, was the right choice. It can't be helped. If I could have gone back in time, I probably wouldn't have made this unnecessary expense. Still, the design is pretty, and the technician did a great job with the installation.

Furthermore, there are pots or dishes that are exactly needed for the next meal, but they end up in the dishwasher unwashed, making them useless. Of course, for those who cook a lot and have generous portions, the 6-8 place setting is quite insufficient. However, I tend to use small pots and pans, and... I really dislike letting the dishes pile up, so I think using the 6-person capacity, even if it's a bit lacking, was the right choice. It can't be helped. If I could have gone back in time, I probably wouldn't have made this unnecessary expense. Still, the design is pretty, and the technician did a great job with the installation.

The SK dishwasher I used before did not have a drying function, but over 95% of the dishes would be dry about two hours after finishing. Now, if I pre-wash, run the dishwasher in normal mode, and then wipe the water off the dishes (excluding plates), it feels like there is actually more work involved. The second issue is the smell. About two months after purchasing it, I was surprised to hear a fishy smell—like pork or eggs?—coming up from the dishwasher. I usually pre-wash thoroughly, and since it is a 12-place setting, I run the dishwasher less often than I did with the 6-place setting, but the smell persisted, so I searched online and found... It is actually listed in the related search results. They say you just need to put in vinegar and run the sterilization cycle. The smell did go away after I ran the sterilization cycle, but... I am puzzled because the one I used before, even though I used it for two and a half years, never had these problems. I asked an acquaintance who bought the same dishwasher two years before me about these two issues, and they said it is the same for them. The third issue is the water dripping onto the kitchen floor when pre-washing and storing dishes. Also, while this isn't a problem with the dishwasher itself, the 12-place setting is a bit awkward for a family of three. It is inconvenient that I can't wash dishes immediately after a meal because the baskets often don't even fill halfway. (There is a function to wash only the top rack, but if I have pots or pans, I have to lower them to the second level to store them.) Furthermore, there are pots or dishes that are exactly needed for the next meal, but they end up in the dishwasher unwashed, making them useless. Of course, for those who cook a lot and have generous portions, the 6-8 place setting is quite insufficient. However, I tend to use small pots and pans, and... I really dislike letting the dishes pile up, so I think using the 6-person capacity, even if it's a bit lacking, was the right choice. It can't be helped. If I could have gone back in time, I probably wouldn't have made this unnecessary expense. Still, the design is pretty, and the technician did a great job with the installation.

However, I would like to list a few disappointing points. (I did not use the drying function due to the electricity bill.) When running in normal mode, it indicates that it takes over five hours from door opening to natural drying, but even after six hours, dishes and cups with deep sides or rims are still soaked with water. The SK dishwasher I used before did not have a drying function, but over 95% of the dishes would be dry about two hours after finishing. Now, if I pre-wash, run the dishwasher in normal mode, and then wipe the water off the dishes (excluding plates), it feels like there is actually more work involved. The second issue is the smell. About two months after purchasing it, I was surprised to hear a fishy smell—like pork or eggs?—coming up from the dishwasher. I usually pre-wash thoroughly, and since it is a 12-place setting, I run the dishwasher less often than I did with the 6-place setting, but the smell persisted, so I searched online and found... It is actually listed in the related search results. They say you just need to put in vinegar and run the sterilization cycle. The smell did go away after I ran the sterilization cycle, but... I am puzzled because the one I used before, even though I used it for two and a half years, never had these problems. I asked an acquaintance who bought the same dishwasher two years before me about these two issues, and they said it is the same for them. The third issue is the water dripping onto the kitchen floor when pre-washing and storing dishes. Also, while this isn't a problem with the dishwasher itself, the 12-place setting is a bit awkward for a family of three. It is inconvenient that I can't wash dishes immediately after a meal because the baskets often don't even fill halfway. (There is a function to wash only the top rack, but if I have pots or pans, I have to lower them to the second level to store them.) Furthermore, there are pots or dishes that are exactly needed for the next meal, but they end up in the dishwasher unwashed, making them useless. Of course, for those who cook a lot and have generous portions, the 6-8 place setting is quite insufficient. However, I tend to use small pots and pans, and... I really dislike letting the dishes pile up, so I think using the 6-person capacity, even if it's a bit lacking, was the right choice. It can't be helped. If I could have gone back in time, I probably wouldn't have made this unnecessary expense. Still, the design is pretty, and the technician did a great job with the installation.
